scenarioCoverage.scenario: A deterministic source fixture flows through normalized facts, Evidence, the automatic Stage Engine, same-Stage Ranking, and Snapshot output, with an optional independent human reference alongside it.
scenarioCoverage.result: The fixture derives a machine reference, preserves supporting/counter/missing proof and cutoff, and retains the supplied human reference as a separate view.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Candidates from different Stages cannot be ranked as one total order.
scenarioCoverage.result: The runtime filters ranking to the explicitly selected Stage and the focused test asserts that cross-Stage candidates are excluded.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Missing, mismatched, or incomplete evidence cannot produce a guessed machine Stage or Ranking output.
scenarioCoverage.result: Insufficient proof returns an explicit UNDETERMINED machine result with no machine ranking; validation rejects identity, cutoff, and provenance mismatches.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The report renderer cannot bypass the judgment boundary or recompute ranking values.
scenarioCoverage.result: Rendering consumes the validated supplied judgment view, preserves parallel machine/human sections, and produces byte-stable output on repeated rendering.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: New public APIs must be documented.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: All new public judgment types, constructors, getters, and derivation boundaries have Rust documentation in src/features/weekly_radar/runtime/judgment.rs; cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings passed.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Cross-context conversions must live behind the Weekly Radar runtime ACL/application boundary.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: Evidence-to-Stage and Transformation-to-Ranking conversions are private to src/features/weekly_radar/runtime/judgment.rs; architecture tests and make check passed.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Keep automatic Stage derivation evidence-bound and explicit; incomplete evidence must produce Undetermined rather than a guess.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The Stage gate requires independent supporting sources plus counter and missing-proof inventories; incomplete fixtures return MachineStage::Undetermined and no ranking in tests/weekly_radar_judgment_chain.rs.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Keep the machine judgment and human reference as independent views; do not merge, vote, or override either view.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: JudgmentSnapshot stores machine judgments and HumanReference values in separate fields, and the serialization test asserts both sections remain distinct without merge, vote, or override behavior.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Keep renderers read-only: they serialize validated values and never recalculate evidence, Stage, Ranking, or Top5.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: src/features/weekly_radar/runtime/report.rs renders the supplied validated JudgmentSnapshot only; repeated rendering is byte-stable and make check passed.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Use deterministic fixtures and no external network, credentials, secrets, or production publication in tests.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The focused judgment-chain tests use in-memory deterministic fixtures and no network, credentials, secrets, or publication; cargo test --all and make check passed.

risk.detail: The runtime currently bypasses the Evidence, Stage, and Ranking contexts. The main risk is publishing a plausible report whose automatic judgment is not evidence-bound, or accidentally merging the human reference into it; implementation must fail closed and preserve two independent views.

observedIssues.issue: Independent review found that raw source observations, future-effective facts, empty-company coverage, and deserialization could bypass or hide the judgment boundary.
observedIssues.resolution: Kept raw source_* observations fail-closed as explicit UNDETERMINED until a later provider signal extractor supplies judgment.* facts; added explicit company-set derivation, cutoff filtering, nested JudgmentSnapshot validation, RuntimeReportInput validation, persisted-input validation, and regression tests.

residualRisks.detail: Real Provider E2E and calibration evidence are not created by this Work Item; wi-production-provider-e2e and wi-research-calibration-score remain gated successor work.
residualRisks.mitigation: Publish no claim of production judgment quality; preserve UNDETERMINED output and keep the successor tasks gated.

residualRisks.detail: The automatic Stage Engine is a system reference, not a guaranteed truth; its rule coverage and calibration require later empirical validation.
requiredEvidence: later calibration denominator and outcome history
residualRisks.mitigation: Version the rule set, retain proof/provenance, and return UNDETERMINED whenever the evidence gate is incomplete.

residualRisks.detail: The human reference lane is retained separately and is not reconciled automatically; product UX must make the distinction clear.
residualRisks.mitigation: Label both views explicitly and prohibit machine override, vote, merge, or consensus behavior.

reviewReadiness.reason: All required verification passed; residual risk remains documented.

boundaryChecks.userVisibleOutput: system and independent human references rendered as separate sections
boundaryChecks.makeEntrypoints: make check and AI Cockpit verification routes validated
